jobs.title: MEP Project Manager – Data Centers
jobs.jd_full:
Description

MEP Critical Facilities Prime Design Project Manager

WORK LOCATION: REMOTE (WITH OCCASIONAL TRAVEL)

This is a remote position with travel required for project site visits during the Construction Administration (CA) phase and site surveys for existing facilities (brownfield projects). All approved business travel expenses are reimbursed in accordance with company travel policies.

Candidates who prefer an office-based or hybrid work arrangement may discuss available options.

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: 10%–25%

SALARY RANGE: $120,000–$170,000 annually

Job Summary:

Seeking an experienced Project Manager with 5-10 years of experience leading multidisciplinary MEP design teams for mission critical and data center projects. Responsible for overall project delivery, client management, design coordination, schedule and budget management, quality assurance, and oversight of electrical, mechanical, plumbing, fire protection, telecommunications, and utility infrastructure design. Experience with hyperscale data centers, colocation facilities, enterprise campuses, and high-availability critical environments is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary client point of contact throughout project execution.
  • Lead multidisciplinary design teams including mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, controls, security, and telecommunications disciplines.
  • Manage project scope, budget, schedule, and resource allocation.
  • Coordinate with utility providers, AHJs, contractors, vendors, and owner teams.
  • Oversee development through feasibility, concept design, SD, DD, CD, permitting, and construction administration phases.
  • Facilitate design reviews, risk assessments, and quality control processes.
  • Monitor project financial performance and support contract management.
  • Mentor and develop junior engineering and project management staff.

Preferred Experience

  • 5-10 years of engineering consulting or project management experience.
  • Critical facilities experience including data centers, hospitals, central plants, or other mission critical infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9, NFPA, NEC, and local building codes.
  • Experience managing projects from 3 MW to 100+ MW campuses.
  • Strong understanding of MEP systems, utility coordination, and construction administration.

Typical Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
  • PE license preferred.
  • PMP certification preferred.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and client management skills.

COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS & EMPLOYEE PERKS

Health & Wellness Benefits

  • Medical Insurance: Four plan options through UnitedHealthcare, including PPO (Select and Select Plus) and High-Deductible Health Plans (Core and Core Plus). Two Kaiser plan options are available in California only.
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) or Flexible Spending Account (FSA): Tax-advantaged savings options based on medical plan selection.
  • Dental Insurance: Two Delta Dental plan options, both covering eligible preventive care at 100% with no deductible.
  • Vision Insurance: Coverage through EyeMed.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Resources and support for personal and professional well-being.

Financial Protection & Retirement

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Up to 4.5% in total employer contributions, including:
  • Up to 3.5% employer match on employee contributions (100% of the first 1% contributed and 50% of the next 5%).An additional discretionary 1% contribution in company shares for eligible employees who contribute at least 5% and remain employed through December 31.
  • Student Loan Payment Matching: Eligible student loan payments can qualify for employer retirement contributions, even without making 401(k) payroll contributions. Student loan payments and 401(k) contributions can be combined to earn up to the maximum 4.5% employer contribution.
  • Company-Paid Life & AD&D Insurance: Basic coverage equal to one times annual salary, up to $250,000.
  • Company-Paid Disability Insurance: 100% employer-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage.

Work-Life Balance

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Parental Leave

Additional Voluntary Benefits

Employees can further customize their benefits with optional coverage and programs, including:

  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Additional Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance through MetLife
  • Legal Services through LegalShield
  • Identity Theft Protection through LifeLock
  • Periodic Opportunities to Purchase Company Shares Directly

Benefits are subject to plan terms, eligibility requirements, and applicable company policies.

Requirements

Typical Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of engineering consulting or project management experience.
  • Critical facilities experience including data centers, hospitals, central plants, or other mission critical infrastructure.Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
  • PE license preferred.
  • PMP certification preferred.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and client management skills.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Precision Enzymes
jobs.jd_full:
Position: Product Manager, Precision Enzymes (open to Senior Product Manager with commensurate experience)

Position Type: Full-time

Department: Marketing

Location: Boulder, CO (preferred) or remote

Experience: MS and 6+ years of relevant industry experience, including bench experience; PhD a plus. Open to the title of Senior Product Manager with additional experience.

 

Position Summary

Watchmaker is inviting applications for the full-time position of Product Manager or Senior Product Manager, Precision Enzymes & Emerging Technologies based in Boulder, CO (preferred).

The successful candidate will thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and contribute directly to our company culture and success. 

The position provides an opportunity to manage our precision enzyme portfolio, reporting to the Associate Director, MDx & Enzymes Product Management. The Product Manager ensures continuous business success through new product development, OEM commercial strategy, and lifecycle management across the enzyme portfolio, with emphasis on differentiated enzymes. The ideal candidate brings a firm grounding in molecular biology and enzyme-based knowledge across NGS and molecular diagnostics.

 

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the enzyme portfolio, supporting both standalone enzyme products and enzymes integrated into Watchmaker’s NGS and MDx tools solutions.
  • Serve as the enzyme portfolio expert and technical product manager within the organization, engaging credibly with R&D on characterization, scale-up, and OEM technical requirements.
  • Be a key leader in new product development projects in close partnership with key stakeholders.
  • Lead enzyme new product development initiatives and serve as the product management representative for enzyme technologies incorporated into new NGS and MDx tools product development.
  • Support execution of the multi-year product strategy and roadmap across standalone enzyme products and internally integrated enzyme technologies, including opportunity assessment, positioning, financial analysis, and commercialization planning.
  • Support on-market product care and be a champion for product care initiatives required to meet/exceed customer’s forecast and requirements
  • Create and maintain competitive assessments, market trends, and product performance
  • Balance internal platform requirements with external market opportunities to maximize the value of Watchmaker’s enzyme technologies across multiple product lines.
  • Lead high-touch external engagements.
  • Translate market and competitive intelligence into roadmap and product decisions; partner with Technical Marketing on positioning, launch, and sales enablement.
  • Represent enzyme programs in the Portfolio Committee and Product Care, and support on-market product care with quarterly touchpoints.
  • Present to senior leadership in regular business reviews and marketing updates.

Please note:  The above responsibilities are not exhaustive and other similar duties may be required from time to time.

 

Skills and Requirements

The candidate should have a graduate degree (MS or PhD) in molecular biology, biochemistry, or a related field, with 6+ years’ experience. Experience in biotech and a start-up environment are highly desirable.

The following skills and experience are requirements for the position:

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • The ability to multitask, be able to work at a high standard, perform consistently under pressure along with pre-determined deadlines and work without supervision.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to work as an effective member of a team.
  • Good communication and personal task management skills and a high level of self-motivation and initiative.
  • A creative and disciplined approach to problem-solving.
  • Time management and prioritization under deadlines
  • High level of accuracy in documentation, record-keeping, and reporting.
  • Deep molecular biology / enzymology knowledge of DNA- and RNA-modifying enzymes and NGS and/or MDx workflows.
  • Demonstrated OEM / B2B product or commercial experience in enzymes, reagents, or life-science tools, including pricing, custom deals, and partnership / supply dynamics.
  • Track record of defining and launching products, and of documenting customer / product requirements in a quality management system.
  • Experience presenting technical information to audiences with varied scientific backgrounds, and influencing and gaining consensus across cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on familiarity with standard molecular biology techniques such as PCR / qPCR and next-generation sequencing.
  • This position requires approximately 20–25% travel (domestic and international).

 

Education and Experience

  • MS in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific field required; PhD a plus
  • Minimum of 6 years industry relevant experience, including R&D
  • Product Management experience preferred and customer-facing roles considered a plus
  • Experience as part of a new product development core team required; OEM / B2B enzyme or reagent product experience strongly preferred

 

Compensation

The base compensation for the Product Manager, Precision Enzymes role starts at $110,000–135,000 + bonus + equity; actual pay will be adjusted based on skills and experience. Employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off, Holidays, employer covers 75% of base medical plan with buy-up options, EAP (employee assistance program), employer paid dental with a buy-up option, employer paid vision, employer paid $25,000 life/AD&D policy, paid parental leave, and a 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% match.

 

Application Requirements 

To apply for the position, please submit the following in a PDF format on watchmakergenomics.com: 

  • Letter of motivation (upload where it says cover letter)
  • Resume or Curriculum vitae, highlighting relevant qualifications and experience

Applications without a Letter of Motivation will not be considered. Local candidates preferred.

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis and the position will remain open until filled; however, early submission is encouraged as review will begin immediately.

If selected to participate in the interview process, the names and contact information of three professional references who are able to assess your suitability for the position in terms of the specified requirements will be requested.

 

*** NO RECRUITMENT AGENCIES PLEASE

We are only accepting direct applications for this position. We are not working with external recruiters or agencies at this time. Unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruiters will not be considered and will be deemed the property of Watchmaker Genomics.

 

*** WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY/AFFIRMATIVE ACTION EMPLOYER

Watchmaker Genomics is committed to being an equal opportunity employer and creating a culturally diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, or veteran status or any other characteristics as protected by applicable law.

All applicants will be asked if currently eligible to work in the United States of America; and if now or in the future will require visa sponsorship to continue working in the United States.

This position may be subject to pre-employment checks, including driving history check, drug screening and a background check for any convictions directly related to its duties and responsibilities. All pre-employment checks will comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Senior Technical Marketing Manager

About the Role

Attackers are using AI to look more human than ever. Stopping them takes technology that recognizes normal behavior, and prevents when there is a deviation.

As a Senior Technical Marketing Manager, you will be the technical voice that carries Abnormal’s R&D breakthroughs to the market. You are excited to own and deliver the high-impact, customer-facing technical assets that prove the depth, sophistication, and value of our AI-driven security solutions: demos, the technical collateral, and materials that technical buyers trust. Working side by side with Product Management, Engineering, Pre and Post Sales, and Marketing, you will turn what our engineers build into content that engages practitioners, equips our field, and helps close deals.

Our platform keeps growing beyond email into identity and AI security, which means more to build, more to demonstrate, and more complexity to make clear. This is a role for someone who pairs deep technical expertise with exceptional communication, and who excels in turning complicated ideas into clarity. 

What You Will Do

  • Build a library that sells. Develop and maintain a comprehensive library of technical assets, including demo videos, whitepapers, technical blog posts, and interactive demo experiences that articulates Abnormal’s differentiated capabilities to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Translate engineering into messaging. Dig into new features, understand how they work, and turn technical capabilities into market- and fieldready messaging and content.
  • Create guided technical experiences. Independently build and maintain guided experiences that bring Abnormal’s unique value proposition and differentiated capabilities to life.
  • Be our technical authority with analysts. Serve as the senior technical subject matter expert in strategic engagements with industry analysts, clearly articulating the technical superiority of the platform.
  • Prove it and lead the conversation. Produce technical validation and thought leadership content, including benchmark reports, integration guides, and architecture deep dives, that positions Abnormal as the technical leader in email security and AI-driven threat detection.
  • Keep content current as we ship. Establish and maintain the processes that keep technical content accurate and relevant as our products evolve.
  • Own the technical side of launches. Lead the development of technical launch deliverables, including demo scenarios, content, and internal enablement tools, in partnership with Product Management and Product Marketing.

Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in technical marketing, solutions engineering, or a related technical, customer-facing role.
  • A strong background in cybersecurity, email security, or adjacent security domains, with the ability to quickly grasp and explain complex technical concepts, architectures, and threat models.
  • Proven experience owning the end-to-end development of customer-facing technical content, including videos, demo assets, technical blogs, whitepapers, and solution briefs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, strong presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate technical value to both practitioner and executive audiences.
  • Experience working with R&D teams and translating engineering developments into market-facing content.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Strong experience with AI-driven content creation tools, video production, and technical documentation platforms.
  • Must be based in the US

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in email security, AI/ML applications in cybersecurity, or threat detection technologies.
  • Experience with interactive demo platforms and customer engagement tools.
  • A background in technical sales or solutions engineering roles.
  • A Master’s degree in a relevant technical field.
  • Industry certifications in cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM, etc.).

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:

$153,000—$200,000 USD

A note on AI in our process: 
Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI’s policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. Our customers are utilities managing a complex electrical grid, supporting the daily lives of millions of people.

Our Implementation Services team is seeking an experienced Program Manager to support the launch of new programs and integrations with our utility clients. This role will facilitate the onboarding of utility customers for thermostat, battery, and EV programs that enable flexibility at all levels of the grid. The Program Manager will work in close partnership with our Client Success, Partner Solutions, Marketing, and Engineering teams.

This is an execution-focused engagement for a strong program manager with experience in the energy sector and a proven ability to drive complex, cross-functional launches.

Scope of Work

  • Program launch support: Support the implementation and launch of EnergyHub’s thermostat, battery, and EV programs with utility clients, delivering program launch content, developing project plans, and coordinating work streams against dedicated launch timelines.

  • Client and stakeholder engagement: Lead client calls to gather requirements, guide utility client stakeholders and internal cross-functional teams to ensure the EnergyHub platform is configured and ready to launch on time, and proactively escalate risks when necessary.
  • Pipeline and capacity management: Track and report on the priorities of programs in the launch process, providing visibility into capacity across launch teams between active launches and incoming programs in the sales pipeline.
  • Project planning and documentation: Build, manage, and maintain current project plans used to launch programs, ensuring accuracy and alignment across all involved teams and stakeholders.
  • Process improvement: Identify opportunities to improve existing processes and tools such as project management platforms and communication practices.

What You Need

  • 6+ years of program management experience, with a strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional, and  initiatives
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, including the ability to independently manage assigned launch projects through completion
  • Experience with project management tools and methodologies
  • A demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively among cross-functional and client stakeholders
  • Experience in the utilities and/or broader energy industry
  • Familiarity with SaaS products and configurable platforms

Helpful Skills and Experience

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Project Management team

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Run a customer project from kick-off to go-live, keeping budget, timeline and project hygiene on track.
  • Be the day-to-day contact for your customer, and tell them early when something is slipping.
  • Work with delivery engineers and solution architects in your pod to turn what the customer needs into a plan the team can deliver.
  • Use our shared delivery skills and AI tools to cut manual project admin, and flag where they fall short.
  • Learn from your delivery lead and bring proposed answers, not just questions.
  • Help us improve how we run projects as you learn what works.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Delivered something to a deadline with other people depending on you (work, university or a side project), and be able to say exactly what you did.
  • Used AI in your work or studies day to day, and be able to explain what it produced and how you checked it.
  • Taken feedback and changed how you work, with an example.
  • Gone beyond the surface of a problem to find out what was really going on.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You’d prefer a long runway of shadowing before taking on real responsibility. You’ll own a customer project early, with coaching alongside you.
  • You’re uncomfortable being the person customers turn to when something goes wrong or when there is hard news to deliver.
  • You wait for direction rather than forming a view and bringing it to the team.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.
  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).
  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.
  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.
  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.
  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.
  • Income protection and Life Insurance.
  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).
  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.
  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.
  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes
  • Manager Interview - 60 minutes
  • Skills presentation - 60 minutes
  • Values Interview - 60 minutes
  • Meet the CEO - 30 minutes

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer’s are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager, Evals & Annotations
jobs.jd_full:
About Arize

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace, so teams can ship faster with confidence.

Arize serves a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like Booking.com, Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

The Opportunity

Evaluations are central to how AI developers understand, measure, and improve their applications. As AI systems become increasingly complex and agentic, developers need cohesive workflows to define what good looks like, evaluate behavior, incorporate human feedback, and continuously improve their applications.

We’re looking for a highly technical, product-minded PM to own Evals & Annotations at Arize. You’ll own the end-to-end evaluation lifecycle—from eval creation and execution to human review, analysis, and iteration. This is an opportunity to bring together powerful capabilities into a cohesive, best-in-class developer experience while helping define the future of evaluations in a world of increasingly autonomous and managed agents, including through our integration with Dynatrace.

This role is ideal for someone with strong product and UX opinions who doesn’t just define requirements but actively shapes the experience. You’ll independently explore workflows, build prototypes, and collaborate closely with Design and Engineering to turn ideas into polished, technically sound products. You should be as comfortable working through an interaction design as you are discussing technical tradeoffs with engineers.

While Arize has been acquired, we continue to operate with the urgency, resourcefulness, and hands-on mentality of an early-stage startup. Product, Engineering, and Design collaborate closely, and our founders remain actively involved in product thinking and design. You’ll have real ownership while working directly with our cofounder/CPO in an environment that values initiative, constructive debate, and a willingness to jump in wherever needed.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Arize’s Evals & Annotations product area end-to-end, including eval creation and execution, human review, annotation workflows, and the broader evaluation lifecycle.
  • Set the product strategy and roadmap, balancing customer needs, foundational platform investments, UX improvements, and emerging opportunities in AI and agent development.
  • Drive a best-in-class evaluation experience. Develop strong opinions about how workflows should work, independently prototype solutions, and partner with Design to turn those ideas into intuitive, polished experiences.
  • Shape the future of evaluations as AI development evolves toward autonomous and managed agents, including opportunities within the broader Dynatrace ecosystem.
  • Work closely with Engineering on technically complex problems spanning evaluation execution, backend systems, orchestration, and data infrastructure. Contribute to technical discussions, implementation approaches, and tradeoffs.
  • Spend significant time with customers—typically multiple conversations each week—to understand how they evaluate and improve AI systems, uncover underlying problems, and validate product direction.
  • Collaborate directly with our cofounders and cross-functional teams on product direction, design exploration, and prioritization, bringing independent judgment and turning collaborative thinking into execution.
  • Make clear prioritization decisions across competing demands and drive products from problem definition through launch, adoption, and iteration.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant product management experience independently owning technically complex developer-facing products. We’re flexible on exact years of experience for candidates with exceptional technical depth, product judgment, and ownership.

  • Strong understanding of LLM evaluations and AI development workflows, including automated evals, human feedback, experimentation, and how developers iterate on AI applications and agents.

  • Experience with developer tools, AI infrastructure, ML platforms, or adjacent technical products, with a solid understanding of backend systems and software architecture.

  • Strong technical depth and hands-on engineering ability. We don’t expect you to ship large features as an IC engineer, but we do expect you to:

    • Debug issues independently and navigate code when needed.
    • Put up small fixes or PRs.
    • Build prototypes and technical proofs of concept.
    • Propose technical implementations and reason through tradeoffs.
    • Hold credible technical discussions with engineers.

  • Excellent product and UX instincts.You can independently define and prototype core product experiences, not just write requirements, while partnering effectively with designers and design engineers to refine and ship them.

  • Strong ownership, initiative, and bias toward action. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, making tradeoffs, and getting hands-on without waiting for a fully defined roadmap or direction.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to working with founders, engineers, and designers. You bring strong opinions, engage in constructive debate, and thrive in an environment where responsibilities overlap.

  • Experience working closely with technical customers, with strong communication skills and the ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution.

Bonus Points, But Not Required

  • Direct experience with LLM evaluation platforms, annotation systems, human-in-the-loop workflows, or agent orchestration.
  • Strong backend or platform engineering background, particularly with distributed systems, workflow orchestration, or data infrastructure.
  • Hands-on programming experience and comfort working across backend and frontend technologies.
  • Experience with LLM-as-a-judge, custom evaluators, experiment tracking, datasets, or feedback-driven improvement workflows.
  • Previous engineering experience or substantial hands-on software development experience.
  • Early-stage or high-growth startup experience, particularly in founder-led environments.

The estimated annual salary for this role is between $200,000-$250,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes a comprehensive benefit package, including: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.

While we are a remote-first company, we have opened offices in New York City and the San Francisco Bay Area, as an option for those in those cities who wish to work in-person. For all other employees, there is a WFH monthly stipend to pay for co-working spaces.

More About Arize

Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend’s best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About The Role

Our Growth & Sales teams hear something new from merchants every day: a coverage gap that cost us a deal, a feature our partners keep asking for, a trend in the data nobody has acted on yet. The way we win is by connecting those signals and turning them into something that will grow revenue for Extend and our merchant partners.

We are looking for a GTM Strategy & Program Manager to own that feedback loop for a portfolio of retail verticals. You will listen to what our merchant partners want and need, decide what is worth building, drive the right teams to build it in a scalable way, and make sure your Pod knows exactly how to sell it. Your success shows up in new deals won, existing partnerships grown, and stronger margins on both.

This is a role for someone who presents ideas without hesitation, can hold a room with leaders, and never settles for not knowing the answer.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the feedback loop. Run a regular cadence with Sales, Growth and Analytics to pull together merchant feedback, win/loss reasons and performance data, and turn it into a clear, prioritized view of what we need to build to win more.
  • Grow the top and bottom line. Find the opportunities that win new merchants and expand existing partnerships, and build the business case for each one in terms of revenue and margin impact.
  • Turn merchant needs into scalable solutions. Listen to what our partners are asking for and shape it into products, features and program offerings that work across your verticals, not one-off custom builds.
  • Run the project plan. Set scope, milestones and owners for every initiative, hold teams accountable to deadlines, and raise risks early when something starts to slip.
  • Know exactly what is being built. Understand every feature well enough to explain how it works, who it is for and where its limits are, from requirements through launch.
  • Enable your Pod. Equip your vertical Pod with the playbooks, talk tracks and training they need to sell and use each new feature, and track adoption after launch.
  • Present with conviction. Pitch new ideas to cross-functional partners, executives and leadership, back your recommendations with data, and drive the decision.
  • Go find the answer. When a question comes up that nobody can answer, dig into the data, the contracts or the market yourself and come back with the answer and a recommendation.

Required Qualifications

  • Relevant experience. 5+ years in GTM Strategy, BizOps, or a similar cross-functional role at a fast-paced tech company.
  • Ownership from idea to launch. You have taken an initiative from a customer or partner need through build, launch and enablement, and can point to the commercial results.
  • Project management discipline. You run several initiatives in parallel, set realistic plans and keep cross-functional teams on deadline without being chased.
  • Executive presence. You put ideas in front of people early and often, present to executives with conviction, and hold your ground when you have the data to back it up.
  • A numbers-first mindset. Advanced Excel and strong analytical skills. You size opportunities, build models and root your recommendations in data.
  • Relentless curiosity. You do not accept “we don’t know” as an answer. You go dig it up and report back.
  • An AI-native way of working. You already use AI tools like Claude to research, analyze and move faster, and you pick up new tools quickly.

Nice To Have

  • SQL or BI tool experience
  • Experience in retail, finance, or consulting
  • Exposure to underwriting concepts like frequency, severity and loss ratio

Expected Pay Range: $125,000 - $135,000 per year salaried

*The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

 

Life at Extend:

  • Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.
  • Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.
  • Generous, flexible paid time off policy.
  • 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

jobs.title: PMO Senior Project Manager, Capital Projects
jobs.jd_full:
AMP is applying AI-powered sortation at scale to modernize the world’s recycling infrastructure and maximize the value in waste. AMP gives waste and recycling leaders the power to harness AI to reduce labor costs, increase resource recovery, and deliver more reliable operations. With hundreds of deployments across North America, Asia, and Europe, AMP’s technology offers a transformational solution to waste sortation and changes the fundamental economics of recycling.

_Headquartered in Louisville, Colorado, the Denver Post and BuiltIn Colorado have recognized AMP as one of the state’s top workplaces. AMP has operations and career opportunities outside of Atlanta, Cleveland, Portsmouth, Virginia, and Europe. We’re fostering an environment where passionate individuals can grow and create impact. We seek unconventional thinkers to join our mission to enable a world without waste; at AMP, your contributions have meaning and can spur change. With backing from top-tier investors and national recognition including North American Cleantech Company of the Year, we’re always seeking ways to better our operations, raising the bar on innovation, and looking to collaborate and improve in what we do. Learn more at AMPSortation.com._ 

The PMO Senior Project Manager, Capital Projects is a part of AMP’s centralized PMO and is responsible for owning the day-to-day project management of  complex, high-priority, and cross-functional capital expenditure (CapEx) projects through the full project lifecycle. This role serves as the primary point of accountability for project outcomes, ensuring the project is delivered on time, within budget, within scope, aligned with project requirements, organizational objectives, and meets contractual obligations and deliverables.

The Senior Project Manager works across functional and organizational boundaries to drive execution, establish accountability, manage interdependencies, and maintain transparency into project health. The role applies standardized PMO methodologies, governance processes, tools, and best practices to ensure consistent, effective, and successful project delivery. 

Responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day project outcomes of complex, high-visibility CapEx projects through all phases of the project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, and closeout.
  • Ensure adherence to all applicable contractual, regulatory, and organizational compliance requirements throughout project execution by proactively identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating contract-related risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, while maintaining compliance oversight and supporting timely resolution of contractual obligations.
  • Effectively manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Drive execution across cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and workstreams to achieve project commitments and deliverables.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and performance measures.
  • Monitor and report project health, including progress, KPIs, budget, schedule, risks, issues, and key decisions.
  • Ensure project change control is applied, assessing impact and ensuring approved changes are documented, communicated, and incorporated into project plans.
  • Facilitate and document project meetings, stakeholder discussions, and decision-making sessions.
  • Apply PMO standards, methodologies, tools, and governance requirements, including stage gates and documentation standards. This includes maintaining accurate project documentation, records, decision logs, RAID logs, and project repositories.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project delivery, tools, processes, and stakeholder adoption.

Key Skills

  • Project Management Expertise: Extensive experience successfully leading complex CapEx projects throughout the full project lifecycle.
  • Project Planning & Execution: Advanced proficiency in developing and managing integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, milestones, and resource requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Compliance & Controls: Advanced expertise in analyzing, communicating, tracking, and managing contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements while ensuring compliance and governance adherence.
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making: Strong analytical skills and ability to resolve complex project challenges and provide actionable recommendations
  • Stakeholder Management: Build alignment and maintain effective relationships with project sponsors, functional leaders, and project teams.
  • Communication: Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Performance Management & Reporting: Ability to develop KPIs, assess project health, identify trends, and provide clear status reporting.
  • Technology & Tools: Proficiency with project management, collaboration, reporting, and documentation tools.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience successfully executing capital expenditure (CapEx) projects.
  • Minimum 7-10+ years of progressive project management experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-year CapEx projects.
  • Certification(s): Project Management Professional (PMP) strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of project controls, compliance tracking, cost management, scheduling, procurement, contracting, risk, and change management.
  • Experience working with engineering, operations, finance, installation, supply chain, and legal teams.

 

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

The physical demands described below are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. This role requires regular travel to active industrial and construction environments. Project sites may not be climate controlled and may include noise, dust, moving equipment, uneven surfaces, elevated work areas, and other typical industrial hazards. While performing the duties of this position, the employee may be required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, communicate effectively, and occasionally lift or move up to 45 pounds. Appropriate personal protective equipment and compliance with all site-safety requirements are mandatory.

AMP provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Applicants who identify with a historically underrepresented group are encouraged to apply.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Other Duties

This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive listing of all duties, responsibilities, or activities required of the employee. Responsibilities may change at any time, with or without notice, based on business and project needs.

Equity Grant: The candidate selected for this role will be recommended for a stock option grant commensurate with the position and the candidate’s qualifications.

Benefits Information:

  • Medical - The company covers between 78% to 100% of the premium for Cigna medical healthcare plans depending on the selection.
  • Dental, Vision, Short- and Long-Term Disability
  • Life Insurance: The company covers the cost of Basic Life / AD&D 1 x Salary, option to purchase additional through New York Life
  • Benefits start the day you start
  • HSA Eligible Health Plans, Company Monthly Contributions!
  • 401(k) retirement plan (non-matching)
  • FTO - Flexible Time Off
  • 6 Accrued Sick Days
  • Eight (8) paid holidays

We’ll consider applications until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Payer & Employer Partnerships
jobs.jd_full:
Trial Library is an AI-native research platform with a mission to improve healthcare outcomes by expanding access to precision medicine. 

 

About Trial Library

Trial Library is an AI-native enrollment and care navigation platform that accelerates access to precision medicine. In collaboration with biopharmaceutical manufacturers, payers, and health systems, Trial Library enables the delivery of clinical trials as a standard care option - improving patient access, advancing oncology outcomes, and reducing the total cost of care. Backed by leading healthcare venture capital firms, Trial Library’s platform is currently deployed in 840+ clinics and 3,000+ providers nationwide.

About the Role

Reporting to the Head of Payer Strategy, the Associate Project Manager will support Trial Library’s payer and employer partnerships and make sure partners have a smooth experience from launch onward. This is a hands-on, client-facing role that requires cross-functional collaboration. You will be the day-to-day point of contact for active health plan and employer partners and keep every partner informed, supported, and engaged.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the main day-to-day contact for active health plan and employer partners: keep regular communication going, share updates, and gather feedback.
  • Lead implementation and launch of new partnerships, including eligibility file setup, referral pathways, member communication plans, and integration with existing care management or benefits programs.
  • Own all partner inquiries and troubleshooting, resolving issues quickly.
  • Work cross functionally with the operations, provider partnerships team, and products team leading efforts to ensure all client deliverables are executed on time and with superior quality in mind.
  • Deliver timely, accurate reports to partners on Trial Library’s performance, including member outreach, engagement, navigation, trial matching, and enrollment outcomes.
  • Help the Head of Payer Strategy develop value and ROI reporting that shows the clinical and economic impact of partnerships.
  • Prepare and lead partner presentations, from program launch to quarterly business reviews and renewal conversations.
  • Oversee all partner-facing materials, including member communications, benefit collateral, co-branded outreach, and performance documentation.
  • Track account health and flag chances to expand or renew to the Head of Payer Strategy.
  • Help build scalable processes for partner onboarding, reporting, and account management.
  • Make sure partner communications and data handling follow HIPAA and contract requirements.
  • Stay current on Trial Library’s product offering and value for health plans, employers, and their members.

Your Requirements:

  • 3–5 years of experience in health plan operations, employer benefits, care management, healthcare account management, or customer success.
  • Experience with payer or employer reporting needs, such as engagement and utilization metrics, outcomes, and value or ROI reporting.
  • Familiarity with health plan operations, employer-sponsored benefits, or population health programs.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and handling protected health information (PHI).
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple partners at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a high level of professionalism with internal and external stakeholders.
  • An analytical approach, comfortable using data to drive action and tell a clear story.
  • A bias toward action, stepping in before issues arise.
  • Able to work autonomously.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, or a high-growth startup.
  • Familiarity with oncology, clinical trials, precision medicine, or patient navigation.
  • Experience supporting value-based care programs or payer partnerships.
  • Experience with CRM and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Tableau, Looker).

$108,000 - $135,000 a year

Compensation & On-Site Requirement

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA, with a requirement of three days per week in the office; Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. The salary range for this position is $108,000–$135,000 per year and reflects a good faith estimate of base pay for candidates working in this location. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Why Trial Library

  • Meaningful impact — helping patients access clinical trials faster through better technology and workflows
  • High ownership environment — autonomy to build, test, and influence strategy across the business
  • Collaborative team culture — low ego, high trust, and close partnership across functions
  • Opportunity for growth — join at an early stage with meaningful exposure to company-building and decision-making

Our Core Values

  • Ally is our favorite moniker
  • The broadest reach is worth the effort
  • Celebrate measurable improvements in access and  outcomes
  • Fearless advocates for representation in research
  • Incentives matter to stakeholders choosing our products
  • Taking initiative is actually giving
  • We are accountable for the experience of patients and providers
  • Empathy and humility are the real dynamic duo

Our Benefits & Perks

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents, along with disability, life, and supplemental insurance options designed to support your overall well-being.
  • Time Off & Workplace Support: Flexible paid time off, observed company holidays, and a one-time home office stipend to help you create a productive and comfortable remote workspace within our hybrid environment.
  • Financial & Lifestyle Benefits: 401(k) program, pre-tax HSA and FSA options, commuter benefits, financial wellness resources, and access to legal protection plans to support both short- and long-term planning.
  • Additional Support & Voluntary Benefits: Access to voluntary benefit offerings including pet wellness support, domestic partner coverage, and additional programs that support the diverse needs of our team members and their families.
